analysis: Vancomycin is an antibiotic that belongs to the glycopeptide class, not lincosamides. It acts by inhibiting cell wall synthesis in bacteria. Vancomycin is primarily active against Gram positive bacteria, including MRSA, and has limited activity against Gram negative bacteria.
